title: Destiny's Twin Souls
next_chapter_hook: Just as that wisp of remnant soul was about to speak, Chen Ji's Mental Sea exploded with golden light—the Tianji Record Fragment was vibrating frantically, as if sensing something familiar. Next chapter, the remnant soul awakens, truth and crisis arrive simultaneously.

text.content:
The air in the depths of the forbidden zone was so cold it felt piercing. Each breath was like swallowing broken ice. Chen Ji followed behind Chen Nian, passing through layers upon layers of prohibition formations. The stone steps beneath their feet were no longer the common blue stone of the sect, but black mystic jade that emitted a ghostly glow. This jade was only recorded in ancient texts, said to be capable of preserving souls from dissipation.

Chen Nian's footsteps suddenly stopped before a massive stone gate. The gate was covered with densely packed talismanic characters, those characters twisted and bizarre, unlike any sect classics Chen Ji had ever seen. Instead, they resembled... the characters from the Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: This is where Tianqing Sect originated.

text.content:
Chen Nian's voice echoed in the empty stone chamber, carrying an indescribable emotion. She turned around, those eyes identical to Chen Ji's gazing directly at him, reflecting the bizarre talismanic characters on the stone gate.

Chen Ji noticed her fingers gently stroking her heart position, an action that inexplicably filled him with palpitating dread. Instinctively, he pressed his own chest—the Tianji Record Fragment there was faintly scorching.

dialogue.content: Brother, before you ask me anything, I need to show you something.

text.content:
Chen Nian stretched out her hand, her fingertips drawing a complex trajectory in the void. That trajectory resonated with the characters on the stone gate, and the gate slowly cracked open. A vast, ancient aura rushed toward them. Behind the door was not the secret chamber or coffin Chen Ji had imagined, but a boundless starry sky—no, they were countless intertwined light threads, each emanating faint radiance.

And at the core of those lights were two clusters of spiritual light, tightly embracing each other.

dialogue.content: Can you see it? That's where we come from.

Chen Nian's tears fell without warning, her voice beginning to tremble: "Three hundred years ago, the previous master of the Tianji Record didn't die from the Heavenly Tribulation, but from... Soul Division."

text.content:
Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Soul Division—that was the forbidden technique among forbidden arts, forcibly tearing a complete soul into several pieces, each fragment retaining part of the original owner's memories and consciousness. The cruelty of this technique lay in that all divided souls retained complete perception, yet could never merge again.

And now, Chen Nian told him, the previous master of the Tianji Record died in precisely this manner.

dialogue.content: That senior, before perishing, entrusted two wisps of his remnant soul to two different people. One was cast into the mortal world for reincarnation, the other was secretly preserved by the sect.

text.content: Chen Nian's gaze pierced through those light threads, her voice so low it was like murmuring in a trance: "The reincarnated wisp transformed into an orphan in Chen Village. And the preserved wisp... was injected into the body of a newborn infant girl."

Silence as death filled the stone chamber. Chen Ji felt his heartbeat deafening, each beat questioning everything he had just heard.

He was not alone. From birth to the present, he had never been alone.

Within his body had always resided the remnant soul of another being. That wisp of soul had been silent, dormant, waiting for some moment to awaken. And the reason the Tianji Record Fragment chose him was not due to his talent or fortune—but because this cultivation technique originally belonged to the remnant soul within his body.

dialogue.content: Brother, I'm not your sister. At least, not just your sister.
We are destiny's twin souls. Two halves of the same soul, split apart.

text.content:
This sentence struck Chen Ji's heart like a heavy hammer. His legs went soft, and he had to grip the stone pillar beside him to barely steady himself.

Destiny's Twin Souls.

Not a metaphor, not a figure of speech, but literally—two people sharing one soul. He and Chen Nian were originally two halves of the same person.

No wonder he felt inexplicably familiar when first meeting Chen Nian. No wonder he could sense her danger and pain. No wonder the Tianji Record began showing more and more abnormalities after Chen Nian appeared—because those were not abnormalities, but resonance. Resonance between souls of the same origin.

choice.prompt: Chen Nian's tears stung Chen Ji's eyes and pierced his heart. Facing this earth-shattering truth, he had to make a choice—

choices.description: No matter how cruel this truth, Chen Nian was his only blood relative in this world. He chose to grasp her hand and face all of this together.
choices.visible_cost: Must acknowledge one is not a complete individual
choices.visible_reward: Gain Chen Nian's complete trust, unlock Bloodline Resonance ability
choices.risk_hint: This means he must redefine who he is
choices.process_label: 陈机深吸一口气，向陈念伸出手

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's hand covered Chen Nian's hand back, the touch icy yet inexplicably comforting. He didn't speak, simply gazing at her quietly, letting her release the tears she had suppressed for years.

text.content:
The moment their hands intertwined, the fragment on Chen Ji's chest suddenly emitted a blinding golden light. Those suspended light threads seemed pulled by some force, all rushing toward the two of them, but splitting into two streams in mid-air, respectively entering their Brow Centers.

In that instant, Chen Ji felt a foreign yet familiar power explode within his Mental Sea—another consciousness was slowly awakening.

choices.memory_label: 接受了与陈念命运双生的真相，决定共同面对一切

choices.description: This truth was too terrifying, completely overturning his self-perception. He needed time to digest, time to think alone—even if it meant temporarily pushing Chen Nian away.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily lose Chen Nian's trust, intensify inner struggle
choices.visible_reward: Digest the truth alone, foreshadow later inner awakening
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian might misunderstand his reaction, feeling abandoned
choices.process_label: 陈机后退一步，声音发颤

text.content:
Chen Ji abruptly pulled back his hand and retreated several steps. His face was pale as paper, his chest heaving violently. Chen Nian's outstretched hand froze in mid-air, the hope in those eyes dimming by degrees, transforming into heart-wrenching loss.

She didn't pursue, simply withdrawing her hand silently and lowering her eyelashes.

choices.memory_label: 震惊于命运双生的真相，暂时无法接受

text.content:
No matter what choice Chen Ji made, those two light threads entering his Brow Center had already planted some connection within him. Deep in his Mental Sea, some long-dormant corner began to emit a faint glow—the fragments of another consciousness were slowly凝聚.

That consciousness's memories rushed in like a tide: old attics, stacked classics, countless days and nights studying the Heavenly Secrets arts... and a blurry figure standing at some Cliff Edge, desperately and angrily screaming something.

That was the original master of the Tianji Record—his past life's memories.

dialogue.content: That consciousness... it's about to wake.

text.content:
Chen Nian's voice came from far away, carrying a fear Chen Ji had never heard before. She tightly gripped his sleeve, her knuckles white from force.

Chen Ji felt a violent vertigo attack, the light in his Mental Sea growing brighter and brighter. Some voice began echoing in his ears—that voice aged and weary, yet carrying an indescribable majesty.

『Finally... I've waited for this day.』

choice.prompt: The remnant soul's voice echoes in his Mental Sea, Chen Ji must decide how to respond—

choices.description: Since they were destined to coexist, why not try to understand this uninvited "roommate"? Chen Ji chose to open his heart, letting that consciousness sense his existence.
choices.visible_cost: Proactively cede partial Mental Sea control
choices.visible_reward: Obtain partial memory inheritance from the remnant soul, accelerate Tianji Record repair
choices.risk_hint: The remnant soul might use this opportunity to seize more control
choices.process_label: 陈机闭上眼睛，主动放开了识海的屏障

text.content:
The light in the Mental Sea suddenly softened. When Chen Ji stopped resisting, that consciousness instead appeared cautious, as if afraid to disturb something precious. It approached slowly, gently touching Chen Ji's own consciousness.

Countless images flooded into his mind—in a single moment, a lifetime of that senior, from a spirited young genius, to a lonely wandering soul guarding fragments, to the resolute determination to place hope in the future. His loneliness, his regrets, his obsession with the Heavenly Secrets arts... all transformed into emotions Chen Ji could feel.

dialogue.content: 『You are more resilient than I imagined...』 The remnant soul's voice carried a hint of relief. 『Since that's the case, let me tell you the true secret of the Tianji Record—and why the Heavenly Eye has its sights set on us both.』

choices.memory_label: 平和接纳残魂，开始了解天机录的真相

choices.description: Without permission, taking residence within him—this "senior" was far too impolite. Chen Ji chose to defend resolutely, never giving this remnant soul any opportunity to exploit.
choices.visible_cost: Cannot obtain memory inheritance from the remnant soul
choices.visible_reward: Maintain Mental Sea independence, avoid being influenced by the remnant soul's mind
choices.risk_hint: The remnant soul might fall into slumber as a result, miss important information
choices.process_label: 陈机在识海中筑起高墙，冷冷地注视着那道光芒

text.content:
Chen Ji's consciousness transformed into an icy barrier, shutting that remnant soul outside. The light collided with the barrier, emitting a weak hum, retreating as if stung.

『Young man... by doing this, you'll only miss important things.』 The remnant soul's voice carried a hint of resignation, yet without any coercion.

dialogue.content: Chen Nian sensed the disturbance in Chen Ji's Mental Sea, her expression changing slightly: "Brother, you'll hurt it like this! Although it's merely a wisp of remnant soul, it's after all left by the previous master of the Tianji Record..."

choices.memory_label: 警惕排斥残魂，保持识海独立控制权

text.content:
Chen Nian anxiously shook Chen Ji's shoulder, her calls seeming to reach him through a layer of water, blurred and distant. Chen Ji's consciousness was being torn by two forces—one was his own survival instinct, the other was the fragments of information transmitted by that remnant soul.

Among those fragments, Chen Ji saw a shocking scene: the Heavenly Eye was not some specific existence, but a vast net covering the entire cultivation world. The Tianji Record, the Night Walker Record, even the opening of certain ancient forbidden lands... all were pieces it had set in motion.

And he and Chen Nian, from the moment of birth, had already been chosen sacrificial offerings.

dialogue.content: Brother! What are you thinking? Your eyes... they're terrifying.

text.content:
Chen Nian's voice finally penetrated that layer of water. Chen Ji snapped back to reality, discovering that at some point he had clenched his fists tightly, nails deeply embedded in his palms, seeping blood.

His gaze had changed.

That youth who had always presented himself as a废物, now had torrential hatred and icy killing intent churning in his eyes. The Heavenly Eye treated him as a chess piece? Then it had better pray, before being overturned, to never expose its identity.

Because Chen Ji had decided—no matter how fate arranged things, he would never admit defeat.

dialogue.content:
Chen Nian carefully approached, gently grasping his hand. Her fingers were icy, yet trembled slightly at the moment of contact—the perception brought by Bloodline Resonance allowed her to feel the rage and sorrow churning within Chen Ji at this moment.

"Brother, whatever you decide to do, I will accompany you."

text.content:
The light threads in the stone chamber had mostly dissipated, leaving only those faint starlight that once illuminated Chen Ji's Mental Sea still gently falling. Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcefully suppressing the churning emotions, restoring his usual calm expression.

But he knew some things had changed forever.

He was no longer that废物 servant disciple who had accidentally obtained the Tianji Record. He was the vessel of destiny's twin souls, the reincarnation of the Tianji Record's true master—and更是被天道之眼盯上的猎物。

And the hunter?

Someday, he would become the Chess Player.

Just when Chen Ji thought everything was about to return to tranquility, a violent tremor suddenly came from the depths of his Mental Sea. That silent remnant soul consciousness suddenly凝聚 into a clear form—a虚幻人影正盘膝坐在他的识海中央，缓缓睁开了眼睛。

那双眼睛苍老而深邃，仿佛看透了世间一切因果轮常。

『是时候好好谈谈了，小家伙。』

残魂的声音不再是模糊的回响，而是如同近在咫尺的低语。陈机的意识被一股无形的力量牵引，"看见"了那道盘坐在识海中央的身影——那是一位白发苍苍的老者，面容模糊得看不真切，但周身萦绕的气息却让陈机感到一阵窒息般的压迫感。

那是天机录最初的主人。是将天机术法修炼到极致的存在。更是被天道之眼亲手抹杀的……牺牲品。
